CDNA.trigger: Either (a) $53-54 stabilizes, or (b) high-volume reclaim of $65 with MACD histogram turning up
CDNA.entry_convention: small starter (quarter-size) at $53-54 that holds, or buy on high-volume reclaim of $65
CDNA.invalidation: break of $60.9 on volume opens air pocket to 50 SMA near $53.4; core divestiture disclosure argues for staying out even at lower prices
CDNA.reevaluation: Q3 10-Q/print: verify gain-on-sale, continuing-operations revenue vs pre-divestiture base, and what the ~$292M divestiture removed

FRO.trigger: Pullback into $54-$57 that stabilizes for several sessions on contracting sell volume, or reclaim of breakout shelf, with tanker rates elevated and no de-escalation headline causing the decline
FRO.entry_convention: staged: ~$25,000 in $54-$57 zone; second $25,000 for $47.50-$49.50 base or resumption of highs with rate thesis intact
FRO.invalidation: do not buy a decline driven by a ceasefire or other thesis break; confirmed ceasefire holding plus break below ~$50 = war premium unwinding
FRO.reevaluation: monitor BDTI/dirty-tanker fixtures, Hormuz transit data, peer commentary; revisit toward Overweight if record fixtures persist ~1 month without escalation news and price consolidates

HAE.trigger: Limit orders layered across the $114-118 band for first tranche; do not chase $122
HAE.entry_convention: staged accumulation: first tranche via limits $114-118; second tranche on hold-and-reversal off $111.6-114 or weekly close above $122; final tranche on follow-through evidence (sustained accumulation volume, guidance revision embedding CSL rollout, analyst raises beyond $130)
HAE.invalidation: daily close below $108 executed mechanically — breakout structure fails, gap-fill/mean-reversion scenario activates
HAE.reevaluation: CSL NexSys PCS rollout milestones through December 2027; guidance revision embedding CSL economics; refinancing commentary into 2030 maturity
HAE.ambiguity: first-tranche size inconsistent: ~$20-22K (~20% of cash) in summary vs ~$33K (~1/3 of standard allocation) in position sizing

IOVA.trigger: Pullback into $13.30-13.50 support zone where the $12.92 stop is sub-4% risk; no fill near support = no position
IOVA.entry_convention: conditional starter only near $13.30-13.50 support with working stop, never at $14.56; no entry above upper Bollinger
IOVA.invalidation: decisive close below $12.92; break below $12.18 eliminates the event-driven portion
IOVA.horizon: event-driven; reassess within days of ESMO data, full allocation decision within following weeks
IOVA.reevaluation: ESMO print plus two-session cooling-off; rebuild toward full only if data positive, price holds above $13 on expanding volume, and post-event consolidation establishes support; resolve current-assets liquidity question before full allocation

MRNA.trigger: $186-200 bases on contracting volume; hard pass on any $225 breakout chase
MRNA.entry_convention: starter position no more than ~1/3 normal size only on evidence of basing in $186-200 on declining volume; do not short
MRNA.invalidation: close below $200 on expanding volume or any close below $186 confirms momentum failure and validates staying out entirely
MRNA.horizon: 1-3 months (contingent re-engagement window around the November vaccine-season report)
MRNA.reevaluation: confirmed identification of the Aug 19 catalyst plus a strong November vaccine-season print upgrades toward Hold/Overweight
MRNA.ambiguity: stated Stop Loss 225.5 applies to the rejected short side / holder management, not the long re-entry plan (whose stop is below $183); stated Price Target 186 is a downside target while the starter plan targets $225

P.trigger: Limit order ~2.5% of portfolio (~$2,500) in the 140-145 zone; adds conditional

params.final_add_requires: November quarter confirms operating cash flow recovery

P.entry_convention: staged limit accumulation with conditional rungs; size all tranches against gap-through scenario (~118 fill against 127 stop)
P.invalidation: decisive close below ~127-131 that fails to hold, or a second weak cash-flow print, converts to avoid-the-name entirely
P.reevaluation: November-ended quarter operating cash flow recovery; confirmed Nasdaq relisting is a legitimate add trigger
P.ambiguity: initial tranche stated as ~2.5% (~$2,500) in final summary vs ~5% (~$5,000) in position sizing field; only the first tranche is a plain limit — later tranches need demonstrated hold / cash-flow confirmation

PENG.trigger: Staged pullback deployment: ~$1,500 at $72-74, ~$2,000 at $66-68, ~$1,000 at $59-61; total ~4.5% of cash
PENG.entry_convention: staged limits at pullback zones; skip final tranche if decline is disorderly or driven by dilution news; stays below standard allocation until operating cash flow conversion is proven
PENG.invalidation: break below $67 strengthens the avoid call; daily close below $67 stops remaining shares, hard exit below $59; dilutive filing or another weak-OCF quarter = bear confirmation
PENG.horizon: until next earnings or confirmed operating cash flow inflection
PENG.reevaluation: next earnings must show actual positive operating cash flow conversion; any announced equity/convertible raise = reduce further; hold above $72 with volume re-expansion through $84-85 = reassess toward standard weight
PENG.ambiguity: stop for staged entries is ATR-relative (~1.5x ATR below fills), not a fixed price; $67/$59 levels govern existing-share protection, not the new tranches

PGEN.trigger: ~Oct 30 INO-3107 PDUFA resolution; re-evaluate Oct 31 with three-branch playbook
PGEN.entry_convention: post-event only: positive outcome -> 25-30% starter after post-gap pullback holds above 8.50-8.56; clean INO approval -> stay out; ambiguous outcome with continued 7.27-8.50 consolidation -> small ATR-sized long at 7.27-7.06 with tight stop
PGEN.invalidation: daily close below $7.06; break of $7.49 is a warning; clean INO label = Sell on moat compression
PGEN.horizon: event-driven: ~18 days to the Oct 30 PDUFA, re-evaluate Oct 31
PGEN.reevaluation: post-PDUFA branches; next 10-Q must show ~$55M milestone receivable converting to cash and footnote explanation of ~$123M Q1-2026 non-operating charge before any upgrade

QMCO.trigger: Short only: weak-volume bounce stalls below the 10 EMA at $30.33, or confirmed close below $24 targeting $22-23
QMCO.entry_convention: no longs; limited short capped ~1% of portfolio at risk, only on stalled weak-volume bounce below $30.33 or confirmed close below $24; treat $29-30 bounces as exit liquidity for trapped longs
QMCO.invalidation: benign CFO disclosure plus volume reclaim of $30.33 kills the bear thesis — stand down; $30.33 is a reassessment trigger not a guaranteed stop-fill (~$2.80 ATR, gap risk)
QMCO.horizon: days to weeks, keyed to next filing/8-K on CFO departure and recap terms
QMCO.reevaluation: next quarterly filing / 8-K detail on CFO departure, recap covenant terms, going-concern language — any is a gap-down catalyst

params.second_tranche_alt: volume-confirmed post-earnings move materially above 1.98M shares

TEAM.invalidation: sustained close below $200 on expanding volume = trim toward half-position; below $192 exit the tactical tranche; no short exposure under any scenario
TEAM.reevaluation: upcoming earnings print is the sizing gate — second consecutive acceleration quarter with confirmed volume justifies full allocation; verify the unexplained ~$2.1B Dec-25 cash deployment before committing second tranche
